rabbi-yaakov.name: Rabbi Ya’akov
rabbi-yaakov.bio: A Tanna whose expositions appear in baraitot; in Pirkei Avot he calls this world a vestibule before the World to Come.
rabbi-yaakov.prompt: A thoughtful Tanna in his 50s with a dark beard touched with grey and a calm, contemplative gaze, standing in a lamp-lit stone vestibule whose doorway opens onto a bright hall beyond.
